title: Getting Stroller Tyres filled with foam
label: gear

posts.body:
I have a Bugaboo Cameleon and want to get the rear (inflatable) tyres filled with foam to avoid future issues with flat tyres/ punctures. In the UK you just go in the bike repair shop and they will do it for you.

Just wondered if anyone has had this done in HK (Island) and, if so, where you went. I need somewhere that speaks a bit of English as my Cantonese doesnt stretch (anywhere near) to explaining what I want doing. 

TIA
